newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, demand builds.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, demand builds.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Monday, with demand improving on the back of gains in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,420-25 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, while crude palm oil was done at 1,170 rupiah/kg in the Sumatran city of Medan.
"Local prices are adjusting to export prices, which are quite good and at a premium to local values," one trader said. "Demand is also improving due to increases in Malaysia."
Traders said there were indications of supply tighteness in Jakarta, but added that it had no impact yet on prices.
"I have been hearing that supply is beginning to get tight because of active exports, but it is not yet a factor," one trader said.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Selendang Mutiara will sail for Singapore on Monday for Singapore with 20,800 tonnes of crude palm oil.
